PRODUCT HELP / RECOVERY GUIDANCE

Understand the boundary before you repair the work.

Workspace help explains storage, backup, restore, import, sync, and handoff boundaries.

Local-first remains the default.Backup, sync, import, restore, review reconciliation, and institutional transfer remain explicit actions.
LOCALBrowser-local firstPreserve a copy before clearing storage.
BACKUPExplicit recovery copySeparate from sync enrollment.
SYNCConflict-safeNo silent last-write-wins.
RESTOREPrefer restore-as-copyCompare before deleting.
SYNC

Resolve a cross-device sync conflict

Workspace refuses silent last-write-wins when revisions diverge.

  1. Preserve both versions.
  2. Compare revisions.
  3. Choose deliberately.
RECOVERY

Restore without overwriting the source

Restore-as-copy keeps the source independently inspectable.

  1. Inspect integrity.
  2. Restore as a copy.
  3. Compare before deleting.
If Workspace appears damaged:Preserve evidence first and avoid clearing browser storage until a verified copy exists.
